conjecture: Linear attention as a composition in the Vec-matrix bicategory Mat(Vec), where (P o+ Q)(a,c) = (+)_b P(a,b) (x) Q(b,c). ORIGINAL STRONG CLAIM (from PROVE.md): (i) one head = one o+ ; (ii) stacking L heads = iterated o+, so a depth-L linear-attention stack is a SINGLE Vec-matrix (algebroid morphism), realising the vcont-plain-note.tex sec.4 'pipeline = |> / o+' wiring for a real ML primitive; (iii) softmax is the boundary. VERDICT: strong (ii) REFUTED for real (data-dependent) attention -- a live depth-L stack with identity feature map is homogeneous of degree EXACTLY 3^L in its input, so it is a single Vec-matrix only for L=0. The claim becomes a THEOREM in the FIXED-CONTEXT (frozen-KV, phi=id) regime, with TWO functors: contexts compose by o+ (biproduct, the sec.4 menu wiring), depths compose by o+ (matrix product, the sec.4 pipeline wiring). Softmax is not a o+ at all (non-homogeneous + bounded). Main novel content = the degree-3^L invariant (the obstruction) + the identification of fixed-context as the exact o+ regime; single-layer-as-matrix is prior work (Vertechi, O'Neill).

children.approach: Prop A: with u = phi(W_Q q), out(q) = u^T S = (y_{d_phi}) o+ S, the single o+-composition contracting over the FEATURE index b in d_phi. Proof = bilinearity of the pairing + finiteness (reassociation). Identifies sec.3's abstract contraction index b as the feature dimension.

Prop B: S(-) : (Contexts, concat, empty) -> (Mat(Vec)(d_phi,d_v), (+), 0) is a monoid homomorphism, S(C.C')=S(C)(+)S(C'), S(empty)=0. Proof = additivity of the sum defining S; matrix addition IS the biproduct on hom-objects. = linear-attention-as-linear-RNN, container-repackaged as the sec.4 menu/both wiring acting on CONTEXTS.
SOURCE (not load-bearing on the paper): linear attention = linear RNN, S_t = S_{t-1} + phi(k_t)(x)v_t. Prop B is proved independently here; citation is provenance only.

Prop C: frozen (constant-KV) heads with phi=id and chained axes form a full sub-bicategory of Mat(Vec); depth-composite readout = S^1 o+ ... o+ S^L (ordinary matrix product = discrete-coend o+). Non-degenerate instance |b|=4 when value-out feeds next key-feature linearly. Proof = a frozen phi=id head IS the Vec-matrix S; composing = matrix product. Low novelty (linear maps compose by matrix product); content = regime identification.

THEOREM D (main, novel): a live depth-L phi=id linear-attention stack is homogeneous of degree EXACTLY 3^L in its input tokens. Lemma D0: one live layer out_i = (W_V X^T X W_K^T W_Q) x_i is degree-3 homogeneous (S = W_K X^T X W_V^T is degree 2, times x_i degree 1). Induction: degree x3 per layer. Corollary: a o+-composite acts linearly (degree 1) on its argument, so a live stack (degree 3^L >= 3) is NOT a single Vec-matrix for any L>=1 => strong claim (ii) REFUTED. Verified: measured degrees 3,9,27 for L=1,2,3.

Prop D1: softmax readout is not u^T S for any fixed S. (a) non-homogeneous: softmax(a.s) != a.softmax(s), normaliser Z(q) nonlinear; (b) bounded: out(q) is a convex combo of v_j so ||out|| <= max||v_j||, while u^T S is unbounded. Verified: homogeneity residual ~1.2, ||out|| in [0.30,1.39] over 10x-scaled q. Independent of Sargsyan.

CORROBORATION (stronger, external, deep-read): softmax attention cannot be functorial for non-trivial groups (Sargsyan). Supports D1 at the functoriality level; D1 proved independently so not load-bearing.

Prop D2: readout is o+-linear in the FEATURE u=phi(W_Q q) for ANY phi (Prop A used only bilinearity); but nonlinear phi makes q -> phi(W_Q q) nonlinear, so depth-o+ fails in the raw query space (holds only in feature space). Verified for phi=elu+1 to eps.
